utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Wait, what drive repair are we talking about again? I feel like I'm missing something.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Oh, Quinn's organizing a neighborhood repair drive this weekend. We're fixing up spots around here—I've got the list of locations if you want to help.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, the repair drive. I'm still a bit fuzzy on the details—could I see that list of locations? Maybe that'll jog my memory.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Hana, I heard you're organizing a repair drive. Need any help with tools or a hand setting things up?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, thanks for offering, Sam! We could definitely use an extra set of hands—Gus is bringing lumber and his toolbox, and Opal's helping with the layout.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, sounds like a solid team. I'll bring my wire brush and oil to clean up those rusty tools—just let me know when to come by.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, thanks Uli. Could you grab the tool box from my garage?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, and I heard the Andersons are bringing their old truck to help haul stuff, so we should have plenty of room for everyone's broken items!

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Perfect, that saves us a trip. I'll mark them down as the transport crew.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, I'll swing by the community center at 3. Thanks for coordinating this, Rosa!

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, perfect, Ira! I'll have everything set up for you. Thank you so much for stepping up!

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: No problem, Rosa! Happy to help out. See you at 3!

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Mina, remind me—was the repair drive this Saturday or next? I've got it written down somewhere, but, y'know, I lose things in my own pockets.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: It's this Saturday, Oren. You really ought to keep better track of these things.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, this Saturday! Thanks, Mina. I'll try to remember that... maybe I'll tie a string around my finger.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, Kira, do you know if the repair drive is this Saturday or next? I heard something about it but I'm not sure.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, are you actually considering going to that thing? I thought it was just one of those neighborhood gossip ideas that never actually happens.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, really? I thought it was for real — someone mentioned it's supposed to start on our block after Elm Street.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks Gus, that heavy-duty tool will be perfect for the repair drive. I'll swing by your shed in a bit to grab it.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: And we'll load it all into my pickup. I'll have it ready by Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect, Eli! That works great. I'll make sure everything is ready to load on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Bo, I've got some tools ready for the repair drive. What do you need?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, thanks Gus. Honestly, I'm not sure yet—Rosa's got the sign-up sheet. Can you check with her?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Alright, I'll swing by Rosa's place and see what tools she needs me to bring.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Alright, let's roll out—Maple Street first, then the warehouse district. Tools are in the truck.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Got it, Dane. I'll follow behind with the Anderson's truck—just let me know if we need to stop for any school pickup detours.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Perfect, Faye. No school runs planned—should be a straight shot to Maple.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, the repair drive is this Saturday. Ira offered to help with flyers.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Saturday, huh? That's sooner than I thought—let me double-check that the tools are in working order before then.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks Hana, that'd be great. I'll meet Ira to hand off the flyers later today—want me to update you when that's set?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That's a relief, Eli. How much can it carry? We don't want to make multiple trips.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I've got a couple of sturdy bins in the garage if you need help hauling things!

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, those would be perfect for keeping everything organized—thanks, Cleo. But we still need to figure out the total weight capacity of Eli's truck so we can plan the load.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Mara, did you hear about the repair drive this Saturday? It's at the community center from 10 to 4—bring anything broken and we'll fix it together!

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yeah, I've been spreading the word! Sam's bringing his lawnmower and Leo's coming with his toolkit. Should be a great day.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh perfect, Noah's also bringing a toaster—so we'll have a real mix of things to fix! Can't wait to see everyone there.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Bo, sorry, I can't quite remember—when's that repair drive again? This Saturday or next?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Uh, I think Rosa has the sign-up sheet; I just sort of volunteered to help organize it. Let me check with her.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, Rosa! She's the one with the clipboard. I'll swing by her place later and ask—thanks for the reminder, Bo!

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: So Rey, I’ve got the route all plotted—Maple Street first, then the warehouse district. You ready to keep us on track?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, I think so. But remind me, did we confirm Saturday or Sunday for the warehouse?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: It’s Saturday, Rey. We’ll hit Maple Street in the morning and the warehouse after lunch.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hey Quinn, can you cover the school pickup on Saturday? I'm tied up with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, Faye, I'd love to, but I'll be running around spreading the word and getting supplies for the drive. Maybe Gus could help?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Good thinking, I'll check with Gus. Hope you get plenty of supplies!

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive—right, right! I'll text Sam for you later today, Bo.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Don't forget your broken toaster, Noah! See you Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Right, the toaster! I keep forgetting that thing's been sitting on my counter for months. I'll definitely bring it Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Dane, heard you're organizing a repair drive. Need any help distributing flyers?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Ira, I could definitely use a hand with flyers. Maple Street first, then the warehouse district—you in?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Count me in. Where should I meet you to pick them up?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Cleo, I'm bringing my old lawnmower and some tools for the repair drive. Let me know if you need any extra help.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That's great, Sam! I could use a hand sorting through the spare parts. Want to help me set up the tool-check station?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, Cleo! I'll head over now and give you a hand with those parts.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, you're actually serious about this repair drive thing?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely! The Andersons are even lending their truck for hauling. It's going to be a blast!

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: A truck, huh? So you really think people will actually show up with broken stuff?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Gus! Thanks for coming by—I could really use your steady hands for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Of course, Rosa! I'm happy to help. I've already got my heavy-duty wrench ready to go.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, that's exactly the spirit! I was hoping you could take charge of the bike repair station—your wrench will come in handy there.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, what's the plan for the repair drive this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Well, Gus is bringing a sturdy wrench from his shed, and I swapped pick-up duties with Faye so we can coordinate everything smoothly.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Okay, but what exactly are we fixing? Nobody's told me what the problem is.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Wait, I'm still trying to pin down the date myself—I heard it might be Saturday, but I'm not totally sure yet.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Let's double-check the date together before we commit to anything.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Good idea, let's look it up together—I hate to spread wrong info.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: She can haul a good load—I'd say enough for most of what we'll need in one go.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Alright, that's reassuring. But should we still map out a backup plan in case we end up with more than expected?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Well, we could always recruit a neighbor with a trailer if we're overflowing, but I'd rather stick to one trip with my truck and keep things simple.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Uli, thanks for coming by! Sam's already on board with the lawnmower and tools—think you can help us coordinate the drop-off times?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Sure, I can help with that. I'll be there early to get things organized.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That's perfect, Uli! I'll send you the list of items and times later today.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
